name: asksage-provider
description: Ask Sage model provider for VS Code chat: cache-aware, cost-aware access to Ask Sage's API endpoints in place of the built-in Custom Endpoint (BYOK) route.

asksage.tenant.markdownDescription: Tenant alias (see `config/tenants.js`), or `custom` to use `#asksage.host#`. Application scope: a workspace cannot redirect requests or the bearer token to another host.

asksage.host.markdownDescription: API host used when `#asksage.tenant#` is `custom` (e.g. `api.asksage.ai`). Application scope.

asksage.email.markdownDescription: Account email, used only to exchange the API key for a short-lived access token on `/server` and `/user` endpoints (catalog, rates, budget). Application scope.

asksage.budget.sessionCapTokens.description: Hard stop: maximum estimated Ask Sage tokens for one conversation before requests are refused. 0 disables the cap.

asksage.budget.hourlyCapTokens.description: Hard stop: maximum estimated Ask Sage tokens across all conversations in a rolling hour before requests are refused. 0 disables the cap.

asksage.debug.logRequests.markdownDescription: **Writes full request/response text (prompt content included) to local files** under the extension's global storage, for debugging only. Off by default: the ledger never contains prompt text (`CLAUDE.md` security rule), and this setting is the one opt-in exception. Requests are sent to Ask Sage exactly as with this off; the log files themselves stay on this machine and are never uploaded.
